job.title: Jobgether - Sr. AI-First Test Engineer / QA Lead

tailoring.headline: Senior AI-First Test Engineer / QA Lead – SAP Commerce Cloud & Headless API Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and headless commerce, with proven data-pipeline integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM. Experienced in unit and integration testing (JUnit), CI/CD, production support and AI-assisted analysis. Strong techno-functional consulting skills, translating business requirements into robust e-commerce testable features.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Sr. AI-First Test Engineer / QA Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited about your focus on AI-driven e-commerce quality and headless architectures. With over five years building and testing SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep technical expertise with AI-assisted analysis to deliver reliable, scalable commerce experiences.

bullets.label: API Test Automation
bullets.text: At Rockwell I designed and exposed OCC REST services and created automated integration tests, ensuring API contracts remained stable across migrations.

bullets.label: Headless Commerce Validation
bullets.text: Implemented headless API layers for PWA front-ends at Shell, and verified end-to-end flows with JUnit and functional UI tests, reducing release defects.

bullets.label: Data Pipeline QA
bullets.text: Built and monitored PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee and DataHub, establishing validation checks that caught synchronization errors before production.

bullets.label: AI-Assisted Test Efficiency
bullets.text: Leveraged generative AI to generate test cases, documentation and code reviews, cutting test design time by 30% while maintaining coverage.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to your company’s commitment to pioneering AI-first quality assurance within e-commerce, a vision that aligns perfectly with my experience using generative AI to accelerate test design and documentation. Your focus on headless commerce platforms offers the ideal arena for my deep SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, enabling me to boost test coverage, reduce time-to-market and support your innovative product roadmap.
tailoring.motivation_short: Your AI-driven QA strategy and headless commerce focus match my SAP Commerce Cloud and AI-assisted testing background, motivating me to help raise quality standards and delivery speed.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with AI-assisted testing expertise. I’d love to discuss how I can help your team elevate e-commerce QA and headless API reliability.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your API test suite by integrating OCC contract tests into your CI/CD pipeline and streamline PIM-ERP data validation using AI-assisted scripts. My proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise will also accelerate headless commerce releases and improve overall test coverage.
tailoring.insight: Your posting highlights the need for robust testing of headless commerce APIs; my experience building and validating OCC services for PWA front-ends aligns directly with that requirement.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Sr. AI-First Test Engineer / QA Lead
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of e-commerce API and testing experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Your focus on AI-first testing and headless commerce excites me, and I can immediately contribute by enhancing your OCC test automation and data-pipeline validation. I bring AI-assisted test design, CI/CD expertise, and proven QA leadership. Please find my CV and cover letter attached for your team.
